# A rule that only adds prerequisites must not hide the target's recipe,
# whichever order the two rules appear in.
mk -p 1 -f mkfile after
stdout '^RECIPE after: a b$'

mk -p 1 -f mkfile before
stdout '^RECIPE before: b a$'

-- mkfile --
after:V: a
	echo RECIPE $target: $prereq
after:V: b

before:V: b
before:V: a
	echo RECIPE $target: $prereq

a b:V:
	true
